content: Expo Router forked from React Navigation in SDK 56 (v56 router). No @react-navigation/* imports allowed in app code; use expo-router/js-stack instead of @react-navigation/stack. Stack.Protected (guard prop, SDK 53+) is the recommended declarative pattern for gating routes (e.g. onboarding-complete) instead of manual Redirect components. Native Tabs supports a disabled prop.
